changelog: 1.0.39: split rows get their own title for each half (empty = "…: movies" / "…: series"); "Movies for you" and "Series for you" become the two halves of a single "rest of the ranking" row that can also be merged ("More for you") or show one kind; titles outside the library in the Trending, Popular and Upcoming rows are filtered by minimum TMDb popularity, votes and taste (advanced settings), and Upcoming keeps the most anticipated titles; default title "Popular".
